name: Retro Campus Quartz Watch
description: A unisex quartz watch with a round case, a fabric nylon-tape strap and a day and date window. The day shows in Chinese characters (星期一 for Monday), not English. Six colourways, in a silver or black case, each with a two-tone strap.

supplier.name: Guangzhou Belloshi Watch Industry Co., Ltd.

source.notes: Price ¥28-¥29 from 1 item; costed at ¥28 (₦6,244.78 on the screenshot, 223.03 per ¥). Supplier lists 6 styles; all 6 photographed and listed (owner to choose). STORE RETURN RATE 50.6% (high risk). Dials and straps carry the factory mark "Louie Juelen" (looks like a luxury-house name): cannot be cropped out of the photos, kept out of title and copy; owner to decide. Supplier banner also says "Louis Juren ... 100% genuine": ignore, do not repeat. Day window is Chinese (星期一). Strap is nylon tape per owner; no waterproof or luminous spec given, none claimed. Case size, movement and weight unknown. Style 1/6 named "L-9565 silver shell beige flour lettering tape (s)"; other style codes not shown. Source photos 800x800, upscaled to 1200x1500 so slightly soft. Colour names are ours, from the photos.
